Name: Ilai the Ahohite
Summary: Valient man of David's armies, called the Ahohite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:29: Valient man of David's armies, called the Ahohite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ilai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
